device.category: 8-voice hybrid polyphonic synthesizer (digital oscillators, analogue filters and VCAs), desktop
device.based_on: Original design, 2017; the Summit is two Peak engines with a keyboard.

sources.title: Novation, 'Novation Peak in detail' (online user guide)
sources.note: Oscillators, LFOs, mixer, envelopes, filter, mod matrix, voices, arpeggiator, effects, settings (read up to the pedal pages).

sources.title: Novation, 'Peak hardware overview'
sources.note: Every top panel control (61 callouts) and the rear panel.

sources.title: Novation, 'Peak appendix'
sources.note: Sync tables, 60 wavetables, init patch, mod matrix and FX matrix sources and destinations, full CC/NRPN list.

architecture.polyphony_mode: 8-voice polyphonic (Poly, Poly2) or monophonic (Mono, MonoLG, Mono2); unison 1-8
architecture.patch_memory_note: Patches in banks (Banks C and D initially Init patches); FX saved with the patch; 16 tuning tables and user wavetables.
architecture.summary: Per voice: three NCO oscillators (sine, triangle, saw, pulse or one of 60 five-wave wavetables) with shape, virtual sync and saw density; noise with its own low and high-pass filters; ring mod of Osc 1 x Osc 2; an analogue mixer and VCA gain; pre-filter overdrive; an analogue LP/BP/HP 12/24 dB filter; post-filter drive; and a VCA. Three DAHDSR envelopes, two per-voice LFOs and two global LFOs. Then analogue distortion on all eight voices and digital chorus, delay and reverb in any order or parallel. A 16-slot mod matrix multiplies two sources per slot; a 4-slot FX matrix modulates the effects. Two Animate buttons, CV mod input, two pedal inputs.

modules.name: Voice assigner (MIDI)
modules.description: Receives MIDI notes (no keyboard) and allocates eight voices: poly, mono or unison, with glide and pre-glide. AUDITION plays middle C.

modules.name: Performance controls
modules.description: Animate 1 and 2 (momentary, with Hold), expression pedals, CV mod input, and MIDI mod wheel, aftertouch and bend as matrix sources.

modules.name: Arpeggiator
modules.description: Up, down, up-down 1/2, played, random or chord; 33 rhythms; 1-6 octaves; swing; chance; synced to the internal clock (40-240 BPM) or MIDI/USB.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: NCO oscillator: sine, triangle, saw, pulse or 'more' (60 wavetables of five waves). Shape amount from manual, Mod Env 1 and LFO 1 at once; virtual sync; saw density.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: NCO oscillator: sine, triangle, saw, pulse or 'more' (60 wavetables of five waves). Shape amount from manual, Mod Env 1 and LFO 1 at once; virtual sync; saw density.

modules.name: Oscillator 3
modules.description: NCO oscillator: sine, triangle, saw, pulse or 'more' (60 wavetables of five waves). Shape amount from manual, Mod Env 1 and LFO 1 at once; virtual sync; saw density.

modules.name: Noise
modules.description: Noise generator with its own low-pass and high-pass filters (NoiseLPF, NoiseHPF).

modules.name: Ring modulator
modules.description: Osc 1 x Osc 2.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Five-into-one analogue mixer (Osc 1-3, Ring 1*2, Noise); VCA GAIN sets its output into the envelope stage.

modules.name: Overdrive
modules.description: Pre-filter analogue overdrive.

modules.name: Filter
modules.description: Analogue LP, BP or HP at 12 or 24 dB/oct, with resonance, key tracking (1:1 at 127), envelope, LFO 1 and Osc 3 modulation (up to eight octaves).

modules.name: Filter post drive
modules.description: Per-voice distortion after the filter, before the VCA, so it does not change with the amp envelope.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Per-voice analogue VCA under the amp envelope.

modules.name: Amp envelope
modules.description: DAHDSR: attack to 18 s, decay to 22 s, release to 24 s; delay to 10 s and hold to 500 ms in the menu; velocity, legato or re-trigger, looping repeats.

modules.name: Mod envelope 1
modules.description: DAHDSR: attack to 18 s, decay to 22 s, release to 24 s; delay to 10 s and hold to 500 ms in the menu; velocity, legato or re-trigger, looping repeats.

modules.name: Mod envelope 2
modules.description: DAHDSR: attack to 18 s, decay to 22 s, release to 24 s; delay to 10 s and hold to 500 ms in the menu; velocity, legato or re-trigger, looping repeats.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: Per-voice LFO: triangle, falling saw, square or S&H; Low (0-200 Hz), High (0-1.6 kHz) or Sync; fade in/out or gate, phase, slew, repeats, common sync.

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: Per-voice LFO: triangle, falling saw, square or S&H; Low (0-200 Hz), High (0-1.6 kHz) or Sync; fade in/out or gate, phase, slew, repeats, common sync.

modules.name: LFO 3
modules.description: Global LFO (menu only): triangle, saw, square or random S&H, free or synced; a matrix and FX matrix source.

modules.name: LFO 4
modules.description: Global LFO (menu only): triangle, saw, square or random S&H, free or synced; a matrix and FX matrix source.

modules.name: Distortion
modules.description: Analogue distortion on the sum of all eight voices, after the VCAs.

modules.name: Digital effects
modules.description: Chorus (3 types; chorus, flanger, phlanger modes), delay (to 1.4 s, sync, ping-pong ratios, time modes) and reverb (3 sizes), parallel or in any series order; wet/dry; bypass.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Stereo outputs and headphones; VOLUME sets both.

mod_matrix.name: Modulation matrix
mod_matrix.note: Two sources per slot are multiplied (either at zero gives no modulation); slots on the same destination add. The MIDI chart limits source to 0-16 and destination to 0-36, fewer than the listed 24 sources and 49 destinations added by later firmware.

additional_mod_matrices.name: FX modulation matrix
additional_mod_matrices.note: Global sources only (no per-voice LFOs or envelopes), since the effects act on the voice sum.

indicators.label: OLED display
indicators.function: 4 x 20 characters: patch, menus, and the value of any control being moved.

indicators.label: ACTIVE VOICE LEDs
indicators.function: Show which of the eight voices are sounding.

indicators.label: selector LEDs
indicators.function: Range, wave, shape source, LFO type and range, filter shape and slope, chorus and reverb type.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Per voice: oscillators, ring and noise into the analogue mixer, VCA GAIN, overdrive, filter, post drive, VCA. Then all eight voices into analogue distortion (after the VCAs, so it changes with level and voice count), then chorus, delay and reverb.

behaviours.name: Panel routings
behaviours.rule: LFO 1: oscillator shape and filter. LFO 2: oscillator pitch. Mod Env 1: shape and filter. Mod Env 2: pitch. Amp Env: VCA and (optionally) filter. Osc 3 can modulate the filter. Everything else goes through the matrix.

behaviours.name: Shape
behaviours.rule: SHAPE AMOUNT sets pulse width on pulse, wavefolding on sine, triangle and saw, or position across the five waves of a wavetable. Manual, Mod Env 1 and LFO 1 amounts add; SOURCE picks which the knob edits.

behaviours.name: Mod matrix
behaviours.rule: 16 slots, each multiplying source A by source B into one destination at a set depth; both Direct makes a fixed offset. Slots add on a shared destination. A separate four-slot FX matrix uses global sources only.

behaviours.name: Voice modes
behaviours.rule: Mono (glide always), MonoLG (glide only on legato), Mono2 (voices rotate so envelopes finish), Poly (every note a new voice), Poly2 (repeated notes reuse their voice). Unison 1, 2, 3, 4 or 8 voices per note.

behaviours.name: LFO behaviour
behaviours.rule: LFO 1 and 2 run per voice (independent phase unless Common), with fade in/out or gate, phase reset, slew and a repeat count. LFO 3 and 4 are global and also reach the FX matrix.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: DAHDSR: delay and hold in the menu. LOOP repeats attack-hold-decay up to 126 times or continuously before sustain. Legato triggering applies only in Mono and MonoLG modes.

behaviours.name: Effects
behaviours.rule: Distortion is analogue on the sum. Chorus (2-tap, 4-tap, ensemble; chorus, flanger, phlanger modes), delay (to 1.4 s, sync truncated to fit) and reverb (three sizes) run in parallel or in any series order. BYPASS removes the three digital effects only. All FX settings are saved per patch.

behaviours.name: Settings
behaviours.rule: Settings are global; pressing SAVE in the Settings menu keeps them over power-off and also stores the current patch as the start-up patch.

menu parameters and mod matrix slots (MSB 1-16 per slot)

specifications.mod_matrix: 16 slots x 2 sources; FX matrix 4 slots
specifications.effects: analogue distortion; digital chorus, delay (1.4 s), reverb

omitted_from_source: block diagram image (path taken from the text)
source_inconsistencies: Several passages are carried over from the Summit guide: 'each of Peak's two Parts', 'each of the two Peak synths has 16 slots', and a link to the Summit block diagram.
Filter section: Env Depth is said to follow 'Modulation Envelope 2' with Source at Mod Env, but the panel and envelope text give Mod Env 1.
The noise is 'white noise' in the hardware overview; the noise HPF text repeats a sentence about voice tuning.
The MIDI chart lists matrix sources 0-16 and destinations 0-36, but the appendix lists 24 sources and 49 destinations.
Clock source defaults to Auto in the menu text and Internal in the init patch table.
LFO Repeats (Off, 1-127) appears in the MIDI chart as 'One Shot', range 0-1.
Arp chance is 0-100% in one line and 10-100% in the next.

modelling_gaps.detail: Voice modules are modelled once (scope per_voice); LFO 3/4, distortion and effects are common.
Slot source and destination parameters point to the mod_matrix lists rather than repeating them as enum values.
Pedal configuration, tuning table editing and further settings pages were not read.
